categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches the scantxoutset RPC implementation and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a concurrency bug that can permanently wedging the scantxoutset RPC until the node is restarted. According to the PR description, overlapping calls can cause a progress sanity check to throw before the lock guard is set up, 'leaving the RPC permanently claiming a scan is in progress until the node restarts'.
